description: Asks which Automation inputs a QueryDef parameter admits and what the query returns for each: a declared Long and a declared Text parameter, and an undeclared parameter [pv], each set to Null, Empty, the optional-argument marker (VT_ERROR DISP_E_PARAMNOTFOUND), an empty BSTR, a BSTR with an embedded U+0000, a lone-surrogate BSTR and ordinary typed values. Also asks the failure of a fresh declared-parameter QueryDef opened without a value. Parameter Name and Type are read from the Parameters collection. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
